item.title: The Funny Way That Stand-Up Comics Are Posting on Social Media
item.description: Comedians used to post footage of their performances to build a following. Now, some are finding that comic strip-style panels with captions pack a bigger punch.
item.dc:creator: Sopan Deb

media:content.media:description: Myq Kaplan and other standup comedians are pivoting to text.
